annotations.text:
Map — pull the sheet down to a peek bar (all three) and tell the pins apart.
A · Name tags: every pin is a tag with the place's icon + name, bordered in its space's colour. Readable at a glance; gets crowded when many places sit close together.
B · Tap to peek: small icon pins; tap one and it lifts with its name, and a place card slides up with Directions and Open place. Cleanest map; you tap to learn a name.
C · Names as you zoom: icon pins zoomed out, names appear beside them as you zoom in (like street labels); tap still opens B's card. Best of both, a little more to build.
Place names are yours; the peek bar shows how many places are on the map.
